sql:
SELECT
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, dd.IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') * 100.0 / nullIf(sum(fos.SalesAmount), 0) AS weekend_sales_percentage,
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, dd.IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') * 100.0 / nullIf(sum(fos.SalesAmount), 0) AS weekday_sales_percentage
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS dd
    ON fos.DateKey = dd.DateKey
